scope.objective: Bound intake, automatic context, semantic carry-over, and provider-visible textual tool output without adding a provider turn or changing the provider-visible tool index on resume.

preArtifactWorkingTreeObservation.disposition: Dirty user-owned development tree retained. Exact production identity is local implementation evidence only; no clean or frozen release candidate is claimed.

exitEvidence.requirement: Intake, context, and tool-result budgets are closed and shared.
exitEvidence.evidence: One runtime-limits policy now names the 900-token context ceiling, 6000-character runtime-intake display, and 8000-character semantic carry-over. Aggregate many-block content/details are compacted when their combined text crosses the existing 12000-character or 180-line threshold.

exitEvidence.requirement: Semantic and file-backed compaction preserve quality-critical edges.
exitEvidence.evidence: Carry-over retains goal head/tail, all twelve criterion labels and head/tail, exact verifier commands, changed-file summary, blocker and next-step rules while the full Task Contract remains durable. Tool output retains head, notable failures and tail; its full bounded capture is private mode 0600.

exitEvidence.requirement: Automatic context remains quality-neutral inside a hard token budget.
exitEvidence.evidence: All injectable phase/pressure combinations remain at 240..900 tokens. Existing hybrid context tests still retrieve the relevant source and current-turn snapshot at or below requested 500/700-token budgets, exclude protected content, and preserve low-confidence fallback.

exitEvidence.requirement: Context growth is bounded across resume.
exitEvidence.evidence: A pending automatic task resumes from its durable task/session binding, injects neither another intake nor another automatic context pack, and keeps the semantic carry-over bounded to 8000 characters. Session-specific task compaction still excludes a different session's task.

exitEvidence.requirement: The provider-visible tool index stays stable.
exitEvidence.evidence: The automatic source task exposes only read/bash/edit/write before intake, after task creation, and after exact-session resume, in the same order. No tool schema or registration contract changed.

exitEvidence.requirement: Default efficiency mechanisms add zero model turns.
exitEvidence.evidence: Runtime intake and context are returned as the current before_agent_start message; no sendUserMessage/sendMessage follow-up is emitted. Pending resume returns no new intake/context message and emits zero provider follow-ups.

exitEvidence.requirement: Adversarial aggregate results cannot bypass per-string compaction.
exitEvidence.evidence: 400 content blocks, 2000 detail records, and a mixed single-large-string plus 20000-number payload each collapse to one bounded preview/capture. Actual hook integration preserves exitCode and a notable ERROR while the returned content/details envelope stays below 15000 serialized characters.
